core_obligations: From compactness to a factorization (proof lines 6504-6530): represent E by a module P with property (P); the distinguished triangle of the filtration has boundary delta, and compactness of E lets delta be written as a finite sum of components delta_i : P to F_i P[1]; the composition with the difference map is zero by derived-lemma-composition-zero, which forces delta = 0 since the summand F_i P is mapped via id minus the inclusion into F_{i-1} P; by derived-lemma-split the identity of E factors through the direct sum, and a second compactness argument makes the factorization pass through a finite partial sum; lemma-factor-through-nicer upgrades this to the filtration form of part (2).

From the filtration to compactness (proof lines 6532-6561): by derived-lemma-compact-objects-subcategory it suffices to show P itself compact; property (P) identifies Hom_D(P, M) with Hom_K(P, M) by lemma-hom-derived, direct sums in D(A, d) are computed on graded modules by lemma-derived-products, so it remains to show Hom_K(P, -) commutes with direct sums; the triangulated structure, cohomologicality of Hom in the first variable and the filtration on P reduce this to P a finite direct sum of shifts of A, and the case P = A[k] is clear since Hom(A[k], -) is a cohomology functor.
proof_roadmap: Represent a compact object by a property-(P) module and write the filtration triangle.
Use compactness twice to force the boundary map to vanish and to truncate the factorization to a finite partial sum; upgrade with lemma-factor-through-nicer.
Conversely, reduce compactness of the filtration-form module to Hom in the homotopy category commuting with direct sums.
Filtration step reduces to finite sums of shifts of A, and the shift case is the cohomology functor.
difficulty_reason: The proposition characterizes compact objects of D(A, d) as direct summands of modules with a finite filtration whose graded pieces are finite sums of shifts of A (statement lines 6502-6513). The proof (lines 6515-6561) runs a genuine compactness argument: the boundary of the filtration triangle is forced to vanish through the difference-map structure and the vanishing composition, compactness is used twice to obtain and then truncate the factorization, and the converse threads property (P), the Hom identifications and the triangulated structure down to the shift case. H2: the doubling-trick structure and the two compactness uses are the content, and no step is a bare citation.
